summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## What I found before writing this plan  Since this is auth-adjacent, I read the full path first rather than guessing (no edits made): `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `db/push.ts` schema.
